profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. describes itself as an AI-powered observability leader. Its website says the company offers observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform, aimed at helping organizations innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive better business outcomes. The site presents the platform as turning data into decisions and autonomous actions.

The company's site includes a statement from Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, describing the future of observability as preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. An unattributed quote on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing root cause identification time from hours to minutes.

Public records show Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under ticker DT with SEC CIK number 0001773383. Massachusetts records list 191 litigation exposure entries for the company. The company is also listed under the alias DYNATRACE INC in some records.
